role: analyst (read-only research; no production/memo edits; no commit)
purpose: Forward (OOS) Sharpe expectation for CPM via Deflated Sharpe Ratio + selection-space DoF enumeration. Replaces the in-sample grid-family median (~1.02) as the honest forward central estimate.

anchor.execution_model: month-end signal, T+1 MOO fill, 10 bps/side

selection_space_DoF.documented_grid: K{3,4,5,6} x momentum{faber_voladj,13612U,12m,6m,3m} x lookback{252,504} x weighting{invvol,equal} = 80 cells (40 distinct; lookback degenerate under equal-weight)
undocumented_axes: Canary rule: OR-vs-AND combinator (2) x canary asset pair selection (HYG/TIP vs LQD/IEF/etc, ~3-6)
13612U momentum horizon set {r1,r3,r6,r12} is itself a tuned form vs alternatives (r1,r4,r8,r12; r2,r4,r8,r12; equal-weight horizons) (~3-5)
strict-K partial-safe threshold: 4-of-8 slots chosen out of {1..8} (~5-8)
6-factor design (C,U,R,S,W,P): inclusion/exclusion lattice 2^6=64 nominal; ~6-10 explored on the additive ladder

effective_independent_trials_N.rationale: Trials are heavily correlated: cross-config SR std (0.073 ann) is far below the single-config SR standard error (0.24 ann), so configurations share most of the same return stream. Nominal product overstates independence by ~1-2 orders of magnitude. DSR verdict is insensitive to N across the entire plausible band.

deflated_sharpe.method: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014). SR0 = expected max SR over N trials = sqrt(V_trials)*[(1-gamma)*Z^-1(1-1/N) + gamma*Z^-1(1-1/(N*e))], gamma=0.5772 (Euler-Mascheroni). DSR = PSR(SR0) = Phi( (SR_hat - SR0)*sqrt(n-1) / sqrt(1 - skew*SR_hat + ((kurt-1)/4)*SR_hat^2) ). All SR in per-period units; V_trials = grid SR variance de-annualized to the same frequency.
deflated_sharpe.interpretation: DSR ~ 1.0 (z > 3.9 at every N up to 2000): the 1.19 Sharpe is statistically distinguishable from the expected maximum produced by searching this correlated family of trials. Selection-from-noise ALONE does not manufacture the result; real signal is present. BUT DSR answers 'is skill real', not 'what is forward SR'. The expected-max benchmark SR0 (ann 0.16-0.24) is the SELECTION-INFLATION haircut: ~0.16-0.25 of the 1.19 is attributable to picking the argmax of the search.

selection_deflated_in_sample_sharpe.note: 1.19 minus expected-max selection inflation (0.16-0.25). Convergent cross-check: equals the empirical peak-vs-median gap (1.19-0.94=0.25 grid median; 1.19-1.02=0.17 faber-family region median). Still ideal execution, still 2008-26 regime.

x_execution_realism.note: 0.765 = full EOM+3 cliff (0.91/1.19); 0.93 = disciplined T+1 MOO; central assumes occasional slippage

x_regime_nonstationarity.note: 2008-26 trending/risk-on tailwind; subperiod 2017-26 SR 1.38 vs 2008-16 1.00; cross-asset momentum OOS decay literature ~0.5-0.7 of IS

verdict.critique_band_assessment: Critique's ~0.65-0.85 CONFIRMED and slightly widened on the downside to 0.62. Central ~0.72 (not 1.02).
verdict.headline_status: 1.19 = in-sample peak (argmax, ideal execution). ~1.00 = selection-deflated in-sample. ~0.72 (0.62-0.85) = forward/OOS central expectation.
verdict.honesty_note: DSR is genuinely supportive (skill is real, not a noise artifact); the forward haircut is driven by selection de-peaking, execution realism, and regime non-stationarity, NOT by failing the deflation test.

caveats: DSR is assumption-sensitive: daily frame uses n=4524 (overstates independence for a monthly-rebalanced strategy) and heavy daily excess-kurtosis (4.03); monthly frame (n=217) is more honest on independence and gives an even higher z. Both yield DSR ~ 1.0, so the verdict is robust to frame.
V_trials uses the 80-cell grid variance only; the broader undocumented DoF would raise N and SR0 modestly (still << 1.19). Captured by the N=1000-2000 sensitivity.
Selection de-peak, execution, and regime factors are applied multiplicatively as independent haircuts; if execution slippage correlates with regime stress the low tail could be worse than 0.62.
Forward range is a reasoned synthesis, not a backtest of the forward period; it cannot be validated until OOS data accrues.
Grid SRs are daily-annualized (match anchor 1.1910); monthly-annualized SR of the same series is 1.40, a frequency-convention difference, not an error.
